title: AI Image Prompt Factory PromptRecipe v1.1
description: Constrained enum variable extension of PromptRecipe v1. Envelope remains closed; embedded semantic_spec is validated independently against request.schema.json.

recipe_schema_version.description: PromptRecipe envelope schema revision. Must be exactly 1.1 for constrained variables.

recipe_version.description: Explicit three-component numeric revision. Published revisions are intended to be immutable.

semantic_spec.description: Complete embedded semantic specification. Must be valid without variable substitution. Validated independently with request.schema.json and lint_spec gates.

variables.description: Optional constrained enum variables. At most three. Keys are stable lowercase ASCII identifiers.

type.description: Only enum variables are permitted in v1.1.

target.description: Closed destination set. No JSON Pointer or arbitrary object replacement.

required.description: When true, invocation must supply this variable. Optional variables use the embedded semantic_spec baseline.

choices.description: Distinct nonempty string literals. Baseline target value must be included (enforced in runtime).
